steps.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square 1024x1024 PNG game inventory/action illustration on a TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA background. Completely empty alpha outside the subject and in all gaps and holes. No black or colored backdrop, no gradient rectangle, no checkerboard, no floor, no shadow plane, no UI tile, no frame, no text or numbers. This will overlay textured combat cells: the cell texture MUST show everywhere around the object.
Art direction: dark gothic fantasy, sculptural volume, tactile finely painted aged materials, strong chiaroscuro but readable midtone surfaces and narrow upper-left edge highlights. Muted iron grey, old brown leather, ivory linen, ochre accents; no plastic, cartoon, neon, flat vector or glossy 3D. A strong simple silhouette readable at 40px. Whole object fully visible, centered with about 8% transparent margin. No unintended accessories. Do not create a sheet of variations.
Subject: One bare human foot and short lower leg delivering a forward kick toward the upper right, coarse linen ankle wrapping. No boot, because this is the unequipped basic kick; no torso or other limb.
